tagline: Pure white, black and signal red on a visible twelve-column grid with an off-corner red square, heavy Archivo set tight against Nunito.

palette.description: white, black and a single signal red; no gradients

typography.style: extra-bold grotesque headlines with a rounded humanist body

best_for: Design-led presentations where the grid itself is the decoration. Asymmetric columns put titles left and evidence right.
avoid_for: Warm, personal or illustrative stories; the red square and rigid grid will feel cold.
name: Swiss Modern
